description: Start or reuse this project's Metro dev server. Auto-detects Expo vs bare React Native. Monitors console output for runtime errors and warnings. To bring everything up in one call (Metro + build + verify), use ceraph_start.

clear.description: Clear Metro bundler cache on start

force.description: Restart this project's Metro even when it is already running

projectDir.description: React Native/Expo project directory. Omit when the coding client's workspace identifies one app; supply it to disambiguate projects.

name: rn_metro_start
